summary: Deutsche Mortgage Asset Receiving Corporation, as depositor, reported via Form 8-K that on August 28, 2026 it closed the issuance of Benchmark 2026-V23 Mortgage Trust Commercial Mortgage Pass-Through Certificates and an uncertificated RR Interest under a Pooling and Servicing Agreement dated August 1, 2026. The trust's assets comprise 30 fixed-rate commercial mortgage loans across 58 properties; the Franklin 8 Pack loan participates in a larger whole loan with non-trust pari passu companion loans. This is a routine CMBS securitization takedown rather than a special situation, with Midland servicing and K-Star as special servicer.
